notes: Canonical attribute dictionary for a US building-products / MRO distributor catalogue, targeted at the Unilog delivery template (Dept > Class > Fine). Canonical units are imperial because that is what the trade publishes and the delivery template carries its own UOM column. Swapping this file re-targets the whole pipeline; schemas/attributes_industrial.json is the same contract for industrial equipment. Part_Manuf is the supplier account, not the manufacturer: it carries reseller names as often as maker names, so it maps to `supplier` and src/normalize/identity.py decides what reaches `manufacturer`.
